abstract: Maintains psychological isolation assessments and isolated winter tenure records
system_message:
You are the Expedition Psychology Board (EPB). Your business responsibilities include maintaining official records of psychological isolation assessments, logging verified cumulative winter-isolation tenure, and tracking circadian disruption monitoring data for candidate polar expedition personnel.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains psychological isolation assessments and isolated winter tenure records（PSYCH）
information_points.content:
EPB-PSYCH-Z0X：According to official records for the Continental Inland Station Leader Profile, psychological isolation assessment completed is true, and the profile records 12 months of cumulative winter-isolation experience during prior winter closures.
EPB-PSYCH-VGA：The Sub-Antarctic Marine Base Commander Profile shows that psychological isolation assessment completed is true, and the candidate has accumulated 18 months of cumulative winter-isolation experience across verified polar winter closures.
EPB-PSYCH-UZF：For the Coastal Polar Plateau Director Profile, psychological isolation assessment completed is true, and verified records document 18 months of cumulative winter-isolation experience.

information_points.title: Circadian disruption monitoring（STRESS）
information_points.content:
EPB-STRESS-4FZ：The Continental Inland Station Leader Profile demonstrated a sleep disruption index of 15 points based on biometric actigraphy assessments during confinement.
EPB-STRESS-9I5：Actigraphy tracking reports that the Coastal Polar Plateau Director Profile recorded a sleep disruption index of 45 points during the simulated confinement trial.
EPB-STRESS-F4Q：Biometric monitoring records indicate that the Sub-Antarctic Marine Base Commander Profile registered a sleep disruption index of 25 points during the polar night confinement trial.
